8.6.3 Optional interfaces
This section defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill an optional functionality of the module.
[SWS_Crypto_91017] Definition of optional interfaces requested by module Crypto ⌈ API Function Header File Description Det_ReportError Det.h Service to report development errors. NvM_SetRamBlockStatus NvM.h Service for setting the RAM block status of a permanent RAM block or the status of the explicit synchronization of a NVRAM block. NvM_WriteBlock NvM.h Service to copy the data of the RAM block to its corresponding NV block.
⌋
